A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''mother''' of [[Parja Bralor]]. A member of [[Clan Bralor/Legends|Clan Bralor]], the woman was also the sister of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Rav Bralor]].<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parja Bralor's [[Parent/Legends|mother]] was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] via a mention in the novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', the third entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]], published [[October 30]], [[2007]].
